from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/xinclude.c')
text=p.read_text()
for s in ['xmlFreeNode(cur);','xmlUnlinkNode(cur);','xmlXIncludeIncludeNode(ctxt, i);']:
    idx=text.find(s)
    print('\n---',s,'at',idx)
    print(text[max(0,idx-300):idx+300])
PY
